headline: Ministry of Finance may eliminate ambiguity in the interpretation of aviation leasing, due to which the BEB pursues airlines - lawyer
summary: A generalized tax consultation from the Ministry of Finance may remove ambiguity in interpreting aviation leasing, a matter over which the tax authority pursues airlines, according to a lawyer.
why: Tax treatment of aircraft leasing affects airline costs and the financing structures used by carriers and lessors.
